summary: HealthStream filed a Form 8-K reporting routine quarterly results, updated guidance, and a declared ordinary quarterly cash dividend of $0.035 per share payable August 28, 2026, to holders of record August 17, 2026. Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01 cover standard operational updates and a regular dividend. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender, activist matter, restructuring, or strategic review is present. The filing reflects normal business activity with no unusual capital allocation or structural changes.
